name: TextField
description: Single-line field for the user to type text. Supports a label, a leading icon and a trailing button.

dos: Always provide a visible label (`label`): the placeholder does not replace the label.
Use the placeholder only as a short format example: "name@email.com".
Use `variant="surface"` by default; `classic` if the field should stand out with a shadow; `soft` on neutral backgrounds.
For actions tied to the field (show password, clear) use the `iconButton` slot, not a separate button.
Use `readOnly` if the value can be copied and `disabled` if it is unavailable.

donts.why: A single-line field cuts off the content and does not grow.
Typing invites format errors and does not validate against the list.

donts.case: Using the placeholder as a label
donts.why: It disappears when typing and has low contrast.
TextField does not handle lists or keyboard selection.

related.difference: Appears as a trailing button inside the field.

props.name: variant
props.description: Appearance. surface = light background with border; classic = same with shadow; soft = faint accent fill with no border.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: height 24 / 32 / 40 px, with its text, radius and spacing. 2 is the default.

props.name: disabled
props.description: If true, it cannot be focused or edited. In Figma it is the "disable" value of the `state` axis.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: If true, the value is visible and can be focused and copied, but not edited. In Figma it is the "read-only" value of the `state` axis.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the field. If omitted, it is not shown (in Figma, the `label` boolean hides it). Text size depends on size.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Example text while the field is empty.

props.name: value
props.description: Typed text. In Figma, `state=filled` and `state=read-only` show this text; `state=placeholder` and `state=active` show the placeholder.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. 14px in size 1; 16px in size 2 and 3. aria-hidden.

props.name: iconButton
props.description: Trailing button inside the field (clear, show password): an IconButton. TextField forces variant ghost, color neutral and the matching size on it (see composition.nestedComponents); the consumer only provides icon, aria-label and onPress. It does not exist in size 1.

controlled.name: disabled
controlled.description: Cannot be focused or edited. Text and background use neutral tokens; never opacity.

controlled.name: readOnly
controlled.description: Shows the value; can be focused and copied, not edited.

root.description: Field container (border, background, radius, shadow). The input lives inside.

label.description: Visible label above the field. Associated with the input via htmlFor.

focusRing.description: Not an element: painted with :focus-visible. In Figma it is a layer shown with the focusRing boolean: 4px outer and 2px inner border.

input.description: Native field. Shows the placeholder when empty and the value when filled. The cursor is the native one (in Figma it is a "|" text).

iconButton.description: Slot for an IconButton at the end of the field.

nestedComponents.note: IconButton size depends on the TextField size: 24px in size 2 → IconButton size 1; 32px in size 3 → IconButton size 2. In size 1 there is no button.

height.note: No height token in Figma: loose values. With a visible label the total height grows.

modes.fill: Fills the container width. In Figma, 200px as an example.
modes.fixed: Decided by whoever uses the component.

autoLayout.direction: VERTICAL (label above the field); the field is HORIZONTAL
autoLayout.gap: Between label and field: spacing.1 in size 1; spacing.2 in size 2 and 3

iconButtonSize.note: Size 1 has no button. In size 2 = IconButton size 1 (24px); in size 3 = IconButton size 2 (32px). See composition.nestedComponents.

a11y.name: The label (label) associated via htmlFor. With no visible label, aria-label is required.
keyboard: Escape — does nothing on its own
a11y.focusIndicator: Double ring: 4px outer with colors.accent.accent-alpha.8 and 2px inner with colors.accent.accent.3 (focus-ring layer). The border also changes to accent-alpha.8 in the active state.
a11y.minTarget: At least 24px tall in size 1 (WCAG 2.5.8); 32 and 40 in size 2 and 3.
a11y.contrastNote: Text ≥ 4.5:1 and field border ≥ 3:1 against the background (WCAG 1.4.11). Not measured in Figma; the placeholder uses neutral-alpha.9, which should be checked.

form.note: Figma defines no error, help text or invalid state.

cases: disabled receives no focus and emits no onChange
readOnly receives focus and emits no onChange
the label is associated with the input (clicking the label focuses the field)
with no visible label, aria-label is missing and the accessibility check fails
each variant × state uses the tokens in tokens.bindings

needsReview: Figma default values are marked with ✦ ("surface ✦", "2 ✦", "placeholder ✦"). The component set default in Figma is `classic`, but the ✦ is on `surface`.
Figma has no hover state. There are only placeholder, active, filled, disable and read-only; hover is left undesigned.
placeholder and filled are the same component with or without a value; in Figma they are distinct states. active = focused, with the "|" cursor drawn as text.
disabled only shows the placeholder: there is no variant of a disabled field with a value.
Heights 24 / 32 / 40 with no token (the existing height variables belong to Button). Tokens for size 1 and 3 read only in variant surface + state placeholder.
The 200px width is an example. With a visible label the component grows vertically; Figma leaves it at 32px tall with the label hidden.
classic also uses shadows.shadow-1 in disabled; in read-only it does not.
No error, help text or required field in Figma.
Placeholder contrast (neutral-alpha.9) and border contrast (neutral-alpha.5/.6) not measured.
Size 1 has no trailing button (the iconButton boolean has no effect) and its icon is 14px. The inner IconButton size (24px and 32px) was resolved by measurement: it matches IconButton size 1 and 2.
Ghost variant and neutral color of the inner IconButton: read from the Figma TextField, not verified against the IconButton tokens.
